abstract.t: This document specifies moq-e2ee-00, a versioned profile for end-to- end encryption of MoQ application payloads. Authorized publishers and subscribers share a 32-byte broadcast secret out of band. Each publisher instance mints an epoch and publishes under an opaque broadcast path ending in it. HKDF-SHA-256 derives opaque physical track names and per-track AES-128-GCM keys from the secret and the epoch; grouped frames and datagrams use separate key domains. Media frames and datagrams carry only ciphertext plus a 16-byte tag. The profile binds object identity through derivation and the nonce, not an on-wire header.
